payload.text: Scope update (Dan, 22 Aug 2026): the Makefile must be a REAL Makefile — `make build` actually compiles and produces the binary (go build -o), not just echo the go incantation. Wire the standard targets: build, test, vet, fmt, render-check, coverage, clean. ALSO in scope: refresh the README web-view screenshots (docs/web-*.png) and the demo board example (docs/demo) so they show the current board — labels, links, three-column flow. Screenshots were re-shot 21 Aug but T-13/T-14 features landed since, so they are stale again.
